beaches.name: Psarovolada
beaches.summary: Nude bathing is usual on the twin coves east of Agia Kyriaki. A naturist directory describes the coves as usually totally nude, with dated visitor reports from 2013 and 2017; a Greek travel listicle from August 2025 names it for naturists. Access is a 10-15 minute walk over steep rocks; adjacent Agia Kyriaki itself stays in swimwear.

beaches.name: Achivadolimni & Mavra Gremna
beaches.summary: Nude bathing is usual on Mavra Gremna, the eastern part of the beach. A naturist directory carries reports from 2004 to 2022; the nude share grows eastward from the Achivadolimni bus stop, which stays in swimwear. An August 2015 report found the area windy and not nudist.

beaches.name: Fyriplaka
beaches.summary: Nude bathing is reported west of the big mid-beach rock. A naturist directory carries reports from 2000 to September 2022; the organised eastern part with the beach bar is in swimwear, and an August 2013 report found no nudity.

beaches.name: Paliochori
beaches.summary: Nude bathing is reported at the east end and on the east beach past the rocks. A naturist directory carries reports from 2007 to September 2022; the central section by the tavernas is in swimwear and high-season reports vary day to day.

beaches.name: Triades & Ammoudaraki
beaches.summary: Nude bathing is usual on these seven far-western coves. A naturist directory carries reports from 2010 to 2018; nude use increases with distance from the parking areas. Access is by rough unpaved road and no report newer than 2018 was found.
